title: GreenGateway Connection and Capability Admin API
description: Strict request and safe response contracts used by the Connection, secret-alias, managed OpenAPI, capability inventory, and constrained playground admin APIs. Response definitions intentionally exclude secret IDs, provider locators, ciphertext, nonces, key material, raw upstream topology, and private-key material.

Etag.description: Opaque strong entity tag, including its double quotes.

secret_configured.description: PUT-only redaction marker. true retains the current hidden binding and false clears it.
PUT-only redaction marker. true retains the current hidden binding and false clears it.

client_secret_configured.description: PUT-only redaction marker. true retains the current hidden binding and false clears it.

secret_configured.description: PUT-only redaction marker, matched to the current entry with the same header name. true retains the current hidden binding and false clears it.

MutationAdditionalHeader.description: One secret-backed header injected alongside the primary credential. The name must be a non-reserved HTTP header (never Authorization), must not name the primary credential's header, and must be unique in the list. Any change to the list is a secrets write.

ConnectionReplaceRequest.description: Full replacement. Hidden binding IDs may be supplied by a secrets-writer, or their corresponding configured markers may be round-tripped to retain or clear the current hidden binding.

sanitized_origin.description: Origin-only display value; never includes credentials, query, fragment, or path.

value.description: One-use secret material. Never returned by any response.
One-use replacement material. Never returned by any response.

body_mode.description: Body serialization for generated tools explicitly named under tools.* only.

tools.description: Keyed by generated operationId names, never rename targets. Dynamic source and composite branches remain reserved.

OpenApiOverlayDocument.description: The per-Connection OpenAPI overlay request shape, including declarative request and response transforms.

label_from.description: Label priority. label_source is reserved and contributes no value until label-source support lands.

template.description: Fixed label template. {name} is required by semantic validation; available placeholders are {label}, {name}, and {options}.

parameters.description: Keyed by top-level properties in the generated input schema.

OpenApiOverlayEtag.description: Quoted strong overlay ETag: "overlay:{connection_id}:c{connection_revision}:r{catalog_revision}:o{overlay_revision}". Overlay revision 0 means no overlay is stored; the Connection and catalog revisions prevent stale ETags from becoming valid after overlay recreation or a kind replacement that rebuilds the OpenAPI catalog.

path.description: JSON Pointer locating the rejected overlay field; / identifies the document.

label_summary.description: Human-readable bounded summary; when none match the configured document label sources it states '0 labels matched the configured document label sources'. This does not imply that the document has no titles or descriptions, because label_from may exclude them.

state.description: Bounded resolver state. A durable value set is current only when its overlay revision and source digest match the compiled source declaration.

OpenApiOverlayCompositeReport.description: Reserved response shape for composite overlays; the array is empty until composite support lands.

sources.description: Compile-time source reports projected from the canonical snapshot stored with the overlay; empty when this revision accepts no source declarations.
Compile-time source reports projected from the canonical snapshot stored with the overlay and available after restart without source I/O.
Compile-time source reports persisted atomically with this overlay/catalog publication.

OpenApiOverlayValidationError.description: A failed overlay PUT or preview. No overlay or catalog mutation was committed.

overlay.description: Optional candidate compiled into this preview without storing it.

has_response_root.description: Whether a response-root selector is compiled, without exposing the selector text.

CreateAdditionalHeader.description: One secret-backed header injected alongside the primary credential; secret_id names a header_api_key secret and is required once the Connection is enabled.

error.const: connection secret is referenced by managed connections
